questions.prompt: Two supported Blob accounts will use object replication. Which two prerequisite configurations are needed?

options.text: Enable Blob versioning on source and destination.
options.explanation: Both accounts need versions for this replication feature.

options.text: Enable Blob change feed on the source.
options.explanation: Replication tracks source changes through the change feed.

options.text: Set both accounts' default tier to Archive.
options.explanation: Archive is not a prerequisite or a default account tier.

options.text: Create one stored access policy on every source blob.
options.explanation: Stored policies are not per-blob objects or replication prerequisites.

questions.prompt: New block blobs replicate successfully, but files uploaded last month do not. The policy was created today with its default copy scope. What should you inspect first?

options.text: Whether the copy scope includes existing objects.
options.explanation: The default new-object scope does not backfill all earlier blobs.

options.text: Whether both accounts use identical access keys.
options.explanation: Replication does not require matching account keys.

options.text: Whether both accounts have LRS disabled.
options.explanation: LRS alone does not explain successful new-only replication.

options.text: Whether every source blob has the destination account's name.
options.explanation: Blob names do not need to contain an account name.

questions.prompt: An application wants to write directly into a destination container governed by Azure Blob object replication. What must the design account for?

options.text: Ordinary writes to that destination container are blocked while the policy applies.
options.explanation: Object replication is not an active-active write mechanism.

options.text: Writes automatically merge into the source container.
options.explanation: The configured replication direction does not supply two-way merging.

options.text: Every destination write synchronously updates all source versions.
options.explanation: Object replication is asynchronous and not a reverse write path.

options.text: Selecting Hot automatically makes the destination writable.
options.explanation: Access tier does not remove replication write restrictions.
